descriptionChirho: A masculine proper noun (meaning 'Yah has built up') referring to several individuals in the Hebrew Bible, most prominently Benaiah son of Jehoiada, one of David's mighty warriors and captain of the bodyguard who later served Solomon. Also borne by Levitical musicians and other figures in Chronicles and Ezekiel. The clusters reflect only surface variation: bare citation form, with conjunctive waw ('and Benaiah'), with preposition lamed ('and to Benaiah'), and minor spelling variants. All refer to the same proper name across 2 Samuel, 1-2 Kings, 1 Chronicles, Ezra, and Ezekiel.
